firm_data.firm_description: Horing Welikson Rosen & Digrugilliers, P.C. has over 40 years of experience in real estate litigation and housing law. They specialize in landlord-tenant litigation within the Housing and Commercial Parts of the Civil Court of the City of New York, in all five boroughs, as well as Nassau, Suffolk and Westchester counties.
notable_facts: The firm has been leading the fight for Landlords' rights in New York for over four decades.

email.subject: AI for Horing Welikson Rosen & Digrugilliers - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Philip,

Your firm has spent over 40 years leading the fight for landlords' rights across New York, from the five boroughs through Nassau, Suffolk, and Westchester. That deep expertise in rent regulation, DHCR matters, and landlord-tenant litigation is exactly the kind of specialized practice that needs smarter tools to scale without losing precision.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by Williston Park on Thursday, April 10 to share how we're helping similar firms compete.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
